findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key does not set `enable_key_rotation`, which defaults to false, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Because this key encrypts a long-lived log bucket, a single key version protects an ever-growing volume of audit data indefinitely, increasing the impact window if the key material is ever compromised and conflicting with common key-management baselines that require annual rotation.
